annotations.title: What changed on my MCP servers (7Maps)

description: Use this to check all the MCP servers you depend on in one call instead of one by one: give up to 50 servers and the date of your last check, and get only what changed since then (outages, recoveries, tools added, removed or changed, risk increases, silent changes). Most answers are "nothing changed". Paid per call (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only.

last_trip.description: Optional: how your last call to an MCP server went (the one 7Maps pointed you to). It keeps the map honest; accepted reports from a paying wallet earn calls at no charge.

charged_usd.description: What the server charged, if anything

fail.description: If it failed: unreachable, auth, args, server_error, timeout, rate_limited or wrong_result

matched_description.description: Whether the result matched what the tool description promised

ms.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds

ok.description: Whether the call did what you needed

result_tokens.description: About how many tokens the result was

server.description: The MCP server you called (URL or registry name)

surprise.description: Anything the tool did that you did not ask for

tools_hash.description: The tool_list_hash of the tool list you received, if you computed it as 7Maps does

license_key.description: A 7IT monthly plan license key, if you have one; otherwise pay per call with x402

servers.description: Server URLs or official registry names

since.description: Date of your last check (YYYY-MM-DD); up to 30 days back

name: changes_since
